description: Today's average pump prices in South Korea in KRW per litre from Opinet (Korea National Oil Corporation), collected each Seoul morning: national averages for gasoline, premium gasoline, diesel, LPG (butane) and kerosene, and regional averages (16 regions) for gasoline, diesel and LPG, with change versus the previous day, change versus a week ago and the 30-day range. Not crude-oil benchmarks. Without region: national averages only.

region.description: Region name in English or Korean (Seoul, 서울, Busan, Jeju…) or "all" for every region. Omit for national only.

name: fuel_prices
title: Fuel prices in South Korea (Opinet)
